entries.english:
Criminal cases, settlements of feuds, and other cent court matters, chiefly in the lordship of Haltenbergstetten.

Term: 1558, 1670–1705, 1729, 1746.

Contains: 1. Georg Beyel of Oberstetten’s settlement of feud, a servant of Zaisolph von Rosenberg (quarrel in the castle, threats), 1558; 2. wanted notices from external chanceries and offices, 1660, 1680, 1690, 1700–1705, 1729; 3. protest by the Niederstetten court against the lordship’s appointment of cent court jurors, 160; 4. appointment of Ernst Hammer of Dreischwingen as knacker, 1746.

Extent: 1 file.
